notes: Nissan USA Manuals & Guides page is dynamic (model/year dropdowns filled by AEM lookup JSON under /owners/manuals-guides/_jcr_content/...manualsandguidessear.lookup.json/{model}/{year}/...); nissanusa.com/robots.txt disallows *_jcr_content*, so that endpoint was NOT called. Links were taken from web search restricted to nissanusa.com (how=site_search) and the observed naming patterns were applied to missing years only with Range-GET verification (how=pattern_verified). Two official hosts: www.nissanusa.com/content/dam/Nissan/us/manuals-and-guides/... (current DAM; case-sensitive file names, 'YYYY-Nissan-Model' up to ~2019, 'YYYY-nissan-model' later) and legacy owners.nissanusa.com/content/techpub/ManualsAndGuides/... (still serves PDFs; listed as alt_urls when both exist). All PDFs verified with GET Range bytes=0-1023 -> 206 application/pdf, body %PDF. US editions (Nissan North America; covers mention NissanUSA.com, miles). From MY2017 the owner's manual is titled 'Owner's Manual and Maintenance Information' (maintenance schedule inside); a separate 'Service and Maintenance Guide' exists only 2014-2016 (2017-2026 patterns 404 on both hosts). Warranty Information Booklet and Service & Maintenance Guide are model-agnostic yearly booklets (shared/YYYY/), repeated per line. Rogue variants included: Rogue Hybrid 2017-2019, Rogue Select 2014-2015, 2017 HEV warranty booklet; Pathfinder Hybrid 2014 supplement. Rogue Sport excluded per scope. Not resolved: whether the 2026 Rogue owner's manual also covers the 2026 Rogue Plug-in Hybrid (no separate PHEV manual found by site search). Quick Reference Guides exist but were not collected.
